title: Meta Instagram App Secret as the client_secret of a code exchange and of a long-lived token exchange
summary: A synthetic Instagram App Secret as the client_secret field of a form POST that exchanges an authorization code, as a curl form field, and as the client_secret query parameter of the long-lived token exchange.
rationale: Meta documents the Instagram App Secret as the client_secret field of a POST that exchanges an authorization code with client_id, grant_type, redirect_uri and code (claim instagram-app-secret-carrier-in-code-exchange), and as the client_secret query parameter of the GET that exchanges a short-lived token for a long-lived one, which must be made in server-side code because it includes the app secret (claim instagram-app-secret-carrier-in-long-lived-exchange). The pages show a short placeholder and state no prefix, alphabet or length (claim instagram-docs-use-short-placeholder-secret). Whether the value equals the Meta app secret is unresolved (open question instagram-secret-same-value-as-meta-app-secret) and the case does not choose. The extent is the parameter value only: the Instagram App ID, whose public status is not stated, and the other parameters are outside the span. Contract claims cited: instagram-app-secret/instagram-app-secret-carrier-in-code-exchange, instagram-app-secret/instagram-app-secret-carrier-in-long-lived-exchange.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#243). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value of the client_secret field or query parameter of an Instagram token exchange is treated as a credential. Meta documents the two carriers and the server-side requirement (carrier existence only); the value admission and the extent are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: To get the access token, send a POST request to the https://api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token endpoint with the following parameters: ... client_secret set to your app's Instagram App Secret from the App Dashboard
sources.locator: Step 2. Exchange the Code For a Token

sources.supports: Requests for long-lived tokens must be made in server-side code. These requesting include your app secret which you never want to expose in client-side code or in an app binary that could be decompiled. ... grant_type set to ig_exchange_token ... client_secret set to your Instagram app secret
sources.locator: Step 3. Get a long-lived access token

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
